verdict.rationale: Square documents an Offline Payments capability in its Mobile Payments SDK for Android, a first-party feature for taking payments without connectivity. The evidence gives only a page title and a one-line summary, so the store-and-forward mechanics and scope are unproven. missing for 10: documented store-and-forward/sync behavior when connectivity returns, offline limits and risk terms, evidence for iOS/Square POS/hardware offline mode, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns

citations.quote: Learn how to take offline payments with the Mobile Payments SDK for Android.
